pages: Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, sits at a kitchen table turning back the stiff early pages of one hardback exercise book, his father's. Middle distance: a tin mug, a hurricane lamp. Background: the kitchen window, grey afternoon light.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, writes a line with one carpenter's pencil down the ruled columns of the open book, head bent close. Middle distance: a wall clock, a stove. Background: the kitchen doorway, low evening light.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, stands in the shade of the woolshed doorway, head turned to the window, one hand raised to count. Middle distance: a broom, sheep hurdles. Background: one long steel pump rod rising from the bore, bright midday light.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, runs one fingertip along an old broad stroke of white paint on the dark timber shed wall. Middle distance: an open paint tin, a brush. Background: the windmill above the shed roof, flat grey daylight.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, leans over the tank rim and looks down one white-banded dip stick standing in dark water. Middle distance: the tank hatch, a coil of hose. Background: the bare ridge, hard afternoon light.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, stands beside one green galvanised water tank on the ridge, boots in the mud, the open book held against his chest. Middle distance: the outlet pipe, a leaning fence post. Background: the wide inlet, low winter sun.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, spreads one open exercise book flat on the kitchen table with both hands, two ruled columns of small pencil figures under his thumbs. Middle distance: a stove, a kettle. Background: the kitchen window, low winter light.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, kneels at the concrete stock trough, one galvanised twenty litre bucket held under the delivery pipe, counting. Middle distance: the hose, a wet pool on the concrete. Background: the woolshed and tank on the ridge, bright daylight.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, holds one small four-cup anemometer up in his open palm and looks past it to the mill tail. Middle distance: the wire fence, a muddy track. Background: the timber windmill turning on its pad, still afternoon light.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, stands under the mill tail with one hand out to one small four-bladed fantail fan, watching it spin in the air behind the vane. Middle distance: the platform rail, a ladder. Background: the open paddock, hard sunlight.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, stands directly under the boom as one sheet metal tail vane swings right through the wind and slams into its stop. Middle distance: the platform rail, a ladder. Background: the mill blades and the ridge, bright daylight.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, rules a third column into one open exercise book at the kitchen table by lamplight, a carpenter's pencil in his fist. Middle distance: a hurricane lamp, a plate. Background: one dark window, lamplight only.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, stands in the sunlit woolshed doorway with one round black stopwatch open in his palm, head turned to the sound. Middle distance: the book on the sill, a feed sack. Background: the mill, bright afternoon light.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, stands out in the yard looking steeply up at one broad cast iron mill blade held edge-on, the whole face of the mill turned away. Middle distance: the platform rail, a ladder. Background: a cold grey sky, flat daylight.

Anaru, a Maori man of sixty with grey hair, in a faded blue wool singlet, climbs the last two rungs of the mill ladder and comes up onto the platform, one hand on the rail. Middle distance: the ladder, a fence strainer. Background: the fantail high on the tail, hard daylight.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, grips the platform rail and turns the small fantail spindle slowly with the fingers of his other hand, head down. Middle distance: a worn bracket, an oily rag. Background: the mill blades, bright daylight.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, hooks one long rusty spring back a link shorter over its pin, holding it stretched in both hands. Middle distance: fence strainers, a kerosene can. Background: the mill platform rail, clear morning light.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, swings one long-handled billhook through low thick gorse at the foot of the mill, boots in the wet. Middle distance: a cut pile of gorse, a wheelbarrow. Background: the mill above the gorse, low sun.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, stands in the shaded doorway with his eyes on one white-banded dip stick standing high in the dark tank water. Middle distance: the tank hatch, a length of pipe. Background: the ridge and the mill, evening light.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, kneels on the tank boards with one open exercise book spread on his knee, one finger on a figure. Middle distance: the dip stick, a carpenter's pencil. Background: the tank water and the ridge, soft evening light.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, unfolds one creased card on the shed bench and smooths it flat with both palms, its printing worn to soft grey lines. Middle distance: a pencil, a tin of nails. Background: the open shed door, flat daylight.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, presses one thumb on the last figure in the open exercise book held flat on his knee, brows down. Middle distance: the folded card, a pencil. Background: the tank rim, flat evening light.

Wiremu, a Maori boy of twelve, short black hair, a scarlet red wool jersey over a checked work shirt, sleeves rolled, comes down the mill ladder past one concrete stock trough running over into its drain, water spreading on the grass. Middle distance: the ladder, a coil of hose. Background: the mill above, the gorse cut flat, low sun.
